_about: Katana's catalogue of public web services for GIS > Online Data and the ONLINE verbs (docs/gis_online.md). Providers hold services, services hold layers; a service's licence, attribution, crs, coverage and limits are inherited by its layers unless a layer sets its own, and a provider's licence and attribution by its services. coverage is a WGS 84 longitude/latitude box [west, south, east, north]. verified is the date the endpoint was seen to answer from Katana's own code, and empty when it has only been checked against the publisher's documentation (evidence says where). A user catalogue beside the settings (online_sources.json in the application's configuration folder) adds providers or replaces one with the same id. Services whose terms forbid use by a third-party application are not listed: Vicmap Basemaps (licensed, fee), Landgate SLIP cadastre (personal-use licence), the SA government imagery mosaic (stakeholders only), TASMAP rasters (CC BY-NC-ND) and the NT services found (licence version not stated).
